title: RC KFC bucket aeroplane (magnus effect)
summary: Peter Sripol builds and flies an RC aeroplane whose wings are rotating KFC buckets, using the Magnus effect (Flettner rotors) for lift. It is a hobbyist experiment in unconventional aerodynamics.
why: HN cites it as a fun, concrete demonstration that Magnus-effect rotating cylinders can generate enough lift to fly.

quote.text: But it sure does produce enough lift to let things fly!
